title: Environments
summary: Your personal projects and each organization live in separate environments. Each one keeps its own projects, chats, notes, usage and settings (agents, models, MCP servers, skills and permissions), so nothing from one leaks into another. Your profile, language, theme, plan and two-factor sign-in are the same everywhere, and so is the limit of each agent's plan. An organization's policy (allowed agents, blocked commands, protected files) applies only inside its own environment.
usage: With at least one organization, a selector under the logo lists Personal and your organizations; choosing one reloads the window with that environment's data. Inside an organization's environment the side menu shows only that organization: its card at the top, then Projects, Statistics, Gatehouse, Members, Repositories, MCP and Skills; Organizations, System and Plans appear only in the Personal environment, and Ctrl+K, the shortcuts and the tray menu follow the same menu. A new organization environment starts with the default settings and no projects: turn on what you need in Settings, and use the organization's page to open its general chat or clone its repositories. In Ctrl+K, choose "Switch to environment" for the one you want. Projects you already had for an organization moved to its environment at the first start after updating, and a copy of the old personal database stays next to it. While switching, a loading screen shows until the environment's data arrives; the app does not look for updates on that reload.
